tool.name: 营业流水刷卡与微信就餐统计
tool.description: 支持同时导入营业流水刷卡 Excel 与微信账单，单独深度分析并智能合并到营业流水总盘；自动按餐别价格档位识别【自有-微信】与【非自有-微信】，支持历史数据快照保存与一键载入。
tool.descriptionEn: Integrates card swipe logs and WeChat dining bills with separate and unified analysis, categorizing personnel into own/non-own and WeChat (own-WeChat, non-own-WeChat), with snapshot archive and restore support.
